# College of American Pathologists (CAP)

> The College of American Pathologists is the professional organization for pathologists providing membership, laboratory accreditation, proficiency testing, and quality management resources.

CAP serves pathology professionals with membership programs, laboratory improvement services, and community engagement through PathTogether. The organization offers accreditation, proficiency testing, quality registries, and career development resources for pathologists at all career stages.

## Key Topics

- CAP Membership
- Proficiency Testing
- Laboratory Accreditation
- PathTogether Community
- Professional Development
- Quality Management
- e-LAB Solutions Suite
- Pathologists Quality Registry
- House of Delegates
- Quality Payment Program
- Residents Program
- Member Resources
- Laboratory Improvement
- Competency Assessment

## Membership & Career Development

- [Membership](https://www.cap.org/member-resources/membership): CAP membership overview with career development tools and educational resources
- [Residents Program](https://www.cap.org/member-resources/residents): Free CAP membership program for pathology residents with exclusive benefits
- [Member Resources Hub](https://www.cap.org/member-resources): Hub for exclusive CAP member content and career-stage resources

## Community & Engagement

- [PathTogether Community Platform](https://community.cap.org/home): PathTogether community platform for CAP member networking and engagement

## Services & Products

- [CAP eStore](https://estore.cap.org/OA_HTML/xxCAPibeCZzpHome.jsp): CAP eStore portal for proficiency testing, surveys, and membership services

## Optional Resources

- [AI Search (Experimental)](https://www.cap.org/ai-search): Experimental AI search feature for CAP resources and pathology content
